description: This is a unit test class for the DateUtils utility class, testing date-related calculation functionalities such as week number calculation, year boundary checks, and future date assessments.

classes.name: DateUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various methods in the DateUtils class related to week number calculations and date comparisons.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up mocks for static methods in DateUtils.TimeUtils before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the static mock after all tests.

methods.name: mockFirstWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks currentDateTime to the start of the year and tests week number calculation.

methods.name: mockFortiethWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks currentDateTime to a mid-year week and tests week number calculation.

methods.name: mockLastWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks currentDateTime to the end of the year and tests week number calculation.

methods.name: correctlyGetWeekNumberOfYear
methods.description: Unit test to verify that week numbers are correctly computed.

methods.name: correctlyGetWeeksLeftInYearFromCurrentWeek
methods.description: Tests calculations for remaining weeks in the year from the current week number.

methods.name: correctlyCheckIfDateIsInCurrentYear
methods.description: Tests whether dates are correctly identified as within the current year.

methods.name: correctlyCheckIfDateIsInFuture
methods.description: Verifies correct detection of future dates.
